      "section": "mod-tome/data/talents/psionic/discharge.lua",
      "source": "Your subconscious now retaliates when you take damage.  If the attacker is within range (%d), you'll inflict mind damage equal to the Feedback gained from the attack or %0.2f, whichever is lower.\n\t\tThis effect can only happen once per creature per turn.\n\t\tThe damage will scale with your Mindpower.",
      "source_tag": "tformat",
      "special": null,
      "target": "你的潜意识会报复那些伤害你的人。当攻击者在 %d 格范围内时，你会对目标造成精神伤害，伤害值为因承受此攻击而获得的反馈数值（但不超过 %0.2f）。\n\t\t此效果每回合对同一生物最多只能触发 1 次。\n\t\t受精神强度影响，伤害按比例加成。"
    },
    {
      "args_order": null,

      "section": "mod-tome/data/talents/psionic/dream-forge.lua",
      "source": "The pounding forge of thought in your mind is released upon your surroundings.  Each turn that you remain stationary, you'll strike the dreamforge, inflicting mind and burning damage on enemies around you.\n\t\tThe effect will build over five turns, until it reaches a maximum radius of %d, maximum mind damage of %0.2f, and maximum burning damage of %0.2f.\n\t\tAt this point you'll begin breaking the dreams of enemies who hear the forge, reducing their Mental Save by %d and giving them a %d%% chance of spell failure due to the tremendous echo in their minds for %d turns.\n\t\tBroken Dreams has a %d%% chance to brainlock your enemies.\n\t\tThe damage and dream breaking effect will scale with your Mindpower.",
      "source_tag": "tformat",
      "special": null,
      "target": "你脑海中轰鸣的思想熔炉向四周释放。每回合当你保持静止，你将会锤击梦之熔炉，对周围敌人造成精神和燃烧伤害。\n\t\t此效果将递增 5 个回合，直至 %d 格最大范围， %0.2f 最大精神伤害和 %0.2f 最大燃烧伤害。\n\t\t此刻，你将会打破那些听到熔炉声的敌人梦境，减少它们 %d 精神豁免，并且由于敲击熔炉的巨大回声，它们将获得一个 %d%% 的法术失败率，持续 %d 回合。\n\t\t梦境破碎有 %d%% 几率对你的敌人产生思维封锁效果。\n\t\t受精神强度影响，伤害和梦境打破效果按比例加成。"
    },
